QuestInfo.name: The Perfect Trap
QuestInfo.0: #p3000000# has an important duty for you.
QuestInfo.1: Kaiser plans to lower the city's defensive shields, lure Magnus's army inside, then turn them back on to cause massive damage. He needs you to take care of the Specters while the shields are down. Once they are back on, you'll need to go to the southern border to fight any enemies that appear there.\n\n#rIf you fail this quest, you must forfeit and start over.#k

0.1: Kaiser has a plan to lure Magnus's armies in and crush them all at once! \r\n#L0##b(He explains Kaiser's plan.)#l\n#k
0.2: I'll lift the Protective Shield to allow the Specters inside. You and the troops will hold them as long as you can, then we ambush them...\r\n#L0##bThat sounds a little on the crazypants side.#l\n#k
0.3: Don't you see? With this one blow, we can reclaim Heliseum! It's a risk we have to take.\r\n#L0##bIf Kaiser thinks it's a good idea, I'm in. Who do I need to blow up?#l\n#k
0.4: Most of Magnus's forces are pooling on the southern border. That's where we'll lay our trap. \n#r(Press Accept to move to the battlefield.)#k

1.0: The plan worked! Magnus's armies are in completely disarray! Heliseum is as good as ours!!
